title: Uthama Rasa
desc: Meenu, a bubbly girl, is in love with Chinnaiya, the village leader. Things change when Marudhu, who is the son of Chinnaiya's rival, Parama Thevar, falls for Meenu.

title: Thulasi
desc: A father secretly kills his son's lover and now deviously plans against his daughter Thulasi's love. When she returns to the village, she is venerated as a goddess and must now lead a celibate life.

title: Seevalaperi Pandi
desc: Five villagers, unhappy with the judgments of the chief of their village, join forces with his bodyguard Pandi to kill him. But Pandi gets capital punishment while the others are acquitted.

title: Ashokavanam
desc: When a stalker attacks Mohan and his family, their close friend Inspector Selvam steps in to help them deal with the situation.

title: Thamizh
desc: Following an altercation with some dangerous goons, a man confronts a gangster and joins hands with his adversary to defeat him.
